verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents broad first-party APIs covering voice, SMS/MMS, team messaging, video, fax, data management and system configuration, plus call-handling rules, call logs, event subscriptions and SDKs. That is substantial API coverage of what the UI does, but nothing claims or shows full UI-to-API parity, and some restricted scopes need support approval. Missing for 10: an explicit or verified statement of API/UI feature parity, coverage evidence for admin features like custom roles, cost centers, shared SMS inbox and AI Receptionist via API, a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: RingCentral provides a suite of powerful APIs for voice, SMS/MMS, team messaging, video, fax, data management and system configuration.
